call_questions: Walk us through the exact sequence of permissions you need from DGCA for routine BVLOS deliveries, and what you do if each one slips by two years.
Who is the first customer who will pay, what have they said, and can you get an LOI before the next round?
If a drone drops a medical package or hits something, who is liable today and who insures it?
What can the company earn from before routine BVLOS is allowed (line-of-sight ops, defence, surveying)?
You've told us the regulatory and liability questions get solved once the tech works - argue the opposite case: why might they not, and what would you do then?
What does your operations co-founder own, and how long have the two of you worked together?
what_would_change_our_view: A signed pilot or LOI with a paying buyer, a written regulator-milestone plan with a fallback use case that earns before routine BVLOS approval, and a commercial co-founder who owns liability and insurance.
